outcome: admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
long-term duration of stay at the NICU
cohort: The study participants were 114,359 singletons born in Japan between January 2005 and November 2019.
finding: Maternal prescription of antidepressants within three months before delivery was associated with increased admission to the NICU and other neonatal morbidities, although the absolute risk of severe neonatal morbidity was low.
